svg.text: F-05 · Steel frame + tube cut list
1.5" (38.1 mm) square tube, 16 ga. M = welded machine module. B-* = bolt-together bay sub-frames
M · machine module (welded, rolls in whole)
Total 46.6 m of tube. Buy ≈ 9 × 20 ft (6.1 m) sticks incl. 12% waste.
• Cut lengths are clear lengths between posts (butt joints). Add-ons not shown:
caster plates, VESA mount plates, door sub-frame, sign mounting tabs.
• Bay sub-frames bolt to the machine posts with 6 mm steel tabs and M8 bolts
into rivnuts (F-09). Every bay frame comes apart for doorways.
• Powder-coat after welding. Mask the rivnut faces.
Fabrication drawing set · units mm · do not scale drawings, use dimensions · tolerance ±2 mm unless noted
